comment: The homepage header is transparent and floats over the hero, which the
hero pulls up beneath it with a negative margin. #header and the hero
<section> are SIBLINGS, so HTML_CodeSniffer -- which resolves a
backdrop by walking the DOM ancestor chain only -- sees no background
colour behind the nav text and reports a false contrast failure.
Measured in-browser, the nav sits entirely within the hero's bounds and
the hero has an OPAQUE rgb(7,12,18) base, giving a true ratio of
18.07:1 against the 4.5:1 requirement, in both light and dark mode.
Re-verify with the console probe in DESIGN.md section 9 if the header
Scoped to this URL and this element only -- contrast checking stays on
everywhere else, including the rest of this page.
